# WORKFLOW STATE MACHINE

## FLOW-GOVERNANCE-CHANGE — Governed Skill Workflow change

Purpose: Change Skill Workflow source or governance state while preserving exact authority, deterministic documentation, blocking evidence, and roadmap synchronization.
Critical: TRUE
Entry condition: A scoped Skill Workflow defect, roadmap item, or owner-authorized governance change is selected.
Authority: SKILL.md plus current .workflow project truth and exact Git candidate

### States

- BASELINED
- IMPLEMENTING
- VERIFYING
- READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE
- ACCEPTED

### Legal transitions

| From | To | Action | Authority | Side effects |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BASELINED | IMPLEMENTING | Make the minimum authorized source/spec change after authority and documentation impact are established. | current roadmap phase and accepted scope | candidate source/spec state changes |
| IMPLEMENTING | VERIFYING | Run targeted tests, regenerate affected evidence/docs, and execute required governance validation. | test and governance contract | generated evidence/docs may change |
| VERIFYING | READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE | Require cumulative tests, exact-candidate governance gates, and explicit evidence boundaries. | blocking validator and test results | candidate may be nominated for acceptance |
| READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE | ACCEPTED | Accept only the exact tested/documented HEAD with clean final provenance. | final acceptance evidence | last accepted state may advance |

### Invariants

- Required governance failure blocks acceptance.
- Generated documentation is never repaired by manual patching.
- Roadmap phase and state phase advance in one transaction.
- Performance work cannot silently skip final gates.

### Failure behavior

- Any unresolved authority, test, documentation, or truth failure returns the candidate to repair.
- Unknown optimization impact expands verification scope rather than assuming safety.

### Restart behavior

- Resume from the exact branch/SHA and current .workflow state; do not reconstruct authority from chat memory.

### Rollback behavior

- Revert to the last accepted Git state and preserve failed candidate evidence/history.
